parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, protection, and housing for internal components such as the magnetron, waveguide, and electrical circuits.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower door of the microwave is made of tempered glass with a metal handle, allowing users to access the cooking chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the microwave cavity to prevent radiation leakage and provides visibility into the cooking area.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge to open and close the cooking compartment.

parts.name: Door (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper door of the microwave is made of tempered glass and includes a handle for user operation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper cooking chamber and ensures a secure seal during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on a hinge mechanism.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of durable plastic and contains buttons or a touch interface for user input.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to set cooking time, power level, and other operational parameters.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary but includes movable or touch-sensitive buttons for control input.
